text:
maria: Heads up — after the ingest sidecar bump this morning the payments service latency dashboard lost the long-tail series. p50/p90 look fine but the tail lines are gone :eyes:
eli: Which panels exactly? screenshot?
maria: payments -> latency -> per-route quantiles. The chart shows p50 and p90 but nothing for 95 or 99. here's the dashboard link: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/payments-latency - cropped screenshot attached (shows legend but no lines)
jonah: I can repro in the grafana query inspector. The prom query is returning empty for the p95/p99 series: `histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket[2m])) by (le, route))`
eli: That query used to return series. Did the ingest sidecar change the metric name or label set?
maria: I pulled a raw scrape from one of the new sidecars and see buckets coming through but the `route` label is missing on the bucket metrics. sample: `request_duration_seconds_bucket{le=\"0.1\",instance=\"payments-3\",job=\"ingest-sidecar\"}` — no route label
jonah: Ahh. If the route label is stripped, histogram_quantile collapses the grouping and returns aggregated values that might be folded into p50/p90 panel queries but not the p95/p99 since those panels group by route.
eli: Quick check: run this to see label keys:```kubectl exec -it pod/payments-3 -- curl -s http://localhost:9100/metrics | grep request_duration_seconds_bucket | head -n 5```
maria: ran it, confirmed. The sidecar config now uses `prometheus_relabel_configs` that drops request-level labels to reduce cardinality, and `route` got included in the drop list by mistake. The change was in the release PR https://git.internal/redwood/ops/ingest-sidecar/pulls/142
jonah: Nice find. For mitigation we can either revert the relabel change or patch the relabel config to keep `route`. Which is lower risk for rollout?
eli: Patch the config and restart sidecars in the canary pool first. I'm going to push a hotfix config: remove `route` from `relabel_configs` `-action: drop` block and restart.
maria: Reapplied relabels and restarted canary sidecars. Canaries show `route` on scrape now.
jonah: Grafana query inspector shows p95/p99 series returning for canary instances.
maria: Rolling the rest of the fleet now, ETA ~8m.
eli: After full roll, check dashboards and also run the synthetic check: `curl -s https://api.redwood.ai/payments/health` looped and histogram check script (devops/snippets/check-percentiles.sh) to ensure tails look sensible.
ops-bot: deploy-status: sidecar-config-hotfix deployed to payments canary (2/2) — success
maria: OK fleet rolled, dashboards look normal again. p95/p99 back across routes. Looks like incident resolved, root cause = relabel drop in new sidecar release removed `route` label from histogram buckets.
eli: Filing follow-up action: update PR template to flag relabel changes that drop per-request labels and add a dashboard alert for missing percentile series. I'll open a ticket and assign to infra team.
jonah: Thanks all. Closing thread once ticket is up. :thumbsup:
